title.value: Probabilistic Surrogate Networks for Simulators with Unbounded Randomness
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Probabilistic Surrogate Networks for Simulators with Unbounded Randomness

extractions.description: The paper introduces a framework for automatically structuring and training fast, approximate, deep neural surrogates of stochastic simulators, retaining the interpretable structure and control flow of the reference simulator, even when the number of random variables is stochastic and potentially unbounded. It demonstrates the surrogates\' ability to accurately model a probabilistic program with an unbounded number of random variables and shows how the surrogate modeling technique makes amortized inference in complex black-box simulators an order of magnitude faster, specifically in simulator-based materials quality testing, inferring safety-critical latent internal temperature profiles of composite materials undergoing curing.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper discusses applications in material science and manufacturing, it does not explicitly focus on sustainable development as a central theme. The focus is more on improving the efficiency and accuracy of simulations.
